scope: Implement and replay a matched long-only geometry/K9 study: C3 base-independent raw-market K9 with a hard post-burn-in boundary, plus a deliberately riskier same-base rolling leaf-path K9 challenger whose recent K9-fit rows remain in downstream meta training. Compare in-sample, frozen, quarterly, rolling, and 3/6/9-month same-base arms against the fixed strict-R3 Base+Consensus handoff.

commands: Single-fold strict C3 smoke: 17,356 April 2026 rows; outcome-free 100,000-row Jan--Mar 2025 bundle; zero pre-bundle downstream rows.
Full matched April--July 2026 replay: 235,567 identical long candidates per arm; 16 completed folds; fixed policy replay SL3 / activation 0.5 ATR / giveback 0.25 ATR / H12 / 100-bps-once.

Full matched April--July 2026 same-base in-sample replay: 235,567 identical long candidates per arm; C3 rolling plus 3/6/9-month leaf-path K9; fixed policy replay SL3 / activation 0.5 ATR / giveback 0.25 ATR / H12 / 100-bps-once.
validation.not_run_reason: The result is intentionally not promoted as a bit-for-bit historical canonical replacement: the historical full structural bundle was not persisted and the raw 2024 contract interval is unavailable.
